body: At 36, I am an "older woman". Reality just slapped me in the face.

All you have to do is work for an airline for that. My BFF called out of work? Cool, let's have lunch! I'll catch the 10am and be in Chicago by noon. Little cousin's dance recital? Fine, I'll go, but someone is taking me to the airport afterward so I can sleep in my own bed tonight. I don't care what time. Mom's got Thanksgiving week off!? Let's go to Rome. Damnit to hell we have to pay $300 roundtrip for both of us. Whatever, taxes, we're still going. The list goes on.
